question: Dr. Justice DY Chandrachud, former Chief Justice of India, joined which of the following institutions in May 2025 as a distinguished professor?

options.text: Faculty of Law, University of Delhi (DU)

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Law University, Delhi (NLUD)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Justice DY Chandrachud**, the **former Chief Justice of India (CJI)**, is a distinguished legal scholar and jurist with significant contributions to India’s judicial system. He has been involved in landmark judgments related to fundamental rights, privacy, and constitutional law.
 
• In **May 2025**, he joined the **National Law University, Delhi (NLUD)**, as a distinguished professor, contributing his expertise in law and judicial practices to nurture the next generation of legal professionals.
 
• NLUD is a **premier legal institution in India**, established in **2008**, and is known for its rigorous legal education, interdisciplinary research, and world-class faculty. *Hence, this is the correct option.*
 
• The association of a former Chief Justice with NLUD highlights the institution's commitment to academic excellence and practical legal training, bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-world application.
 
• Other institutions mentioned in the options are also notable but do not match the described scenario of Dr. Justice DY Chandrachud joining as a distinguished professor in May 2025. *Hence, other options are incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Law University, Delhi (NLUD):**

 
 
• NLUD was established in **2008** through the **National Law University Act, Delhi**. It is located in **Dwarka, New Delhi**.
 
• The university offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in law, focusing on interdisciplinary legal education and research.
 
• It is recognized for its contributions to legal education in India, consistently ranking among the **top law schools** in the country.
 
• NLUD is known for its **centers of excellence** that promote research in diverse areas like human rights, intellectual property, and environmental law.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Justice DY Chandrachud:**
 
 
• **Dr. DY Chandrachud** served as the **50th Chief Justice of India** from **November 9, 2022**, to his retirement in **November 2024**.
 
• He is known for delivering landmark judgments on key issues like **privacy (Puttaswamy Case), decriminalization of homosexuality (Section 377),** and **gender equality**.
 
• His tenure as CJI was marked by progressive reforms and efforts to enhance transparency and efficiency in the judiciary.
 
 
 
• **Role of Distinguished Professors:**
 
 
• Distinguished professors bring their practical experience and academic insights to universities, enriching the learning environment for students.
 
• They contribute to curriculum development, mentor students, and often engage in collaborative research.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Institutions in the Options:**

 
 
• **Faculty of Law, University of Delhi:** One of India’s oldest law schools, established in **1924**, offering comprehensive law programs.
 
• **Indian Law Institute (ILI):** Founded in **1956**, it focuses on advanced legal studies and research.
 
• **Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU):** Established in **1998**, offering various undergraduate and postgraduate programs, including law.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Dr. Chandrachud’s Appointment:**
 
 
• His association with NLUD enhances its reputation and provides students with access to unparalleled legal expertise.
 
• It reflects the importance of bridging academia and judiciary for holistic legal education.
